project_title: Steicy Semi-Jóias — Redesign Exclusivo & Alto Ticket
emotional_tone: Exclusive, timeless, warm, artisanal, high-ticket prestige (Haute Joaillerie feel with Portuguese/Azulejo heritage harmony)
design_intent: Elevate Steicy Semi-Jóias from a basic reseller catalog into a high-ticket boutique jewelry experience. The design seamlessly harmonizes with the 56 supplier card photos (1024x1024 warm cream ground, navy-blue azulejo borders, gold typography). We replace the lilac/green palette with an opulent palette of Deep Navy (#0c192c), Warm Ivory/Cream (#fcfaf6), Champagne Gold (#c8a86b), and Polished Onyx/Slate. We replace generic grids with an editorial asymmetrical gallery, refined serif headings (Playfair Display / Cormorant / Cardo), bespoke gold foil badges, elegant category filter tabs, high-contrast WhatsApp concierge CTAs, and quiet luxury transitions.

entry_surfaces./: editorial luxury hero with subtle gold accent hairline, split storytelling header, brand crest badge, and curated high-ticket gallery preview

surfaces.name: nav_crystal

rules.headings: Playfair Display, font-weight 400 or 600, tight tracking (tracking-tight), leading-tight
rules.eyebrows: Plus Jakarta Sans, uppercase, 11px-12px, letter-spacing 0.22em, font-weight 600, champagne gold or deep navy muted
rules.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, font-weight 400/500, line-height 1.6, tracking normal
rules.prices: Plus Jakarta Sans, font-weight 700, tabular numbers, deep navy #0C192C, prominent sizing

catalog_grid.desktop: grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) or repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) with generous 28px-32px gap
catalog_grid.mobile: grid-template-columns: repeat(1, minmax(0, 1fr)) or repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) with 16px gap

layout_and_grids.editorial_featured_hero: Split 2-column showcase on desktop (1.2fr / 1fr), framing the curated piece in an architectural gold-lined card with concierge direct action

product_filter_requirements.hidden_products_rule: Hide the 16 products without photos upfront (refs: 88293, 354878, 354759, 85580, 83620, 88243, 88260, 69071, 82660, 88221, 88229, 88290, 88294, 864569, 85581, 88274). Only render the 55 available products with photo assets.
product_filter_requirements.ignore_ref_87863: Do not create product for unmatched photo ref-87863 as instructed by user.
product_filter_requirements.active_count_display: Display active filtered count dynamically: 'Exibindo X peças exclusivas'

card_treatment.structure: 1:1 square photo container with 0px or subtle 4px inner inset, showcasing the supplier navy/cream frame, surrounded by crisp white card with 1px border (#EAE5DB), subtle ambient drop shadow on hover, gold/navy 'Curadoria / Destaque' chip, metal finish pill (Banho de Ouro 18k / Prata 925), and WhatsApp concierge link button

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: translateY(-4px) on product cards with soft diffused shadow (0 16px 36px rgba(12, 25, 44, 0.08)), smooth border color transition to #C8A86B
motion_and_interactions.button_micro_interactions: scale(1.02) on primary CTAs with subtle gold glow
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { transition: none !important; animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto; }

accessibility.contrast_ratio: WCAG AA compliant (4.5:1 for body copy and 3.0:1 for large text across all surfaces)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.html with the complete redesigned single-file HTML/CSS/JS version.
2. Maintain zero-dependency static setup (served on port 3000 by frontend/server.js).
3. Load Google Fonts Playfair Display and Plus Jakarta Sans in <head>.
4. Upfront filter the PRODUCTS array to only include the 55 products that have corresponding ref-<REF>.png images (exclude the 16 items without photos).
5. Ensure all WhatsApp links point to https://wa.me/5551993614204 with Brazilian Portuguese pre-filled messages mentioning the exact REF code.
6. Keep the promo banner 'Natal Steicy · A cada R$ 100,00 em compras, ganhe um bilhete para concorrer a um conjunto de colar e brincos.' with opulent navy and champagne gold styling.
7. Include all required data-testid attributes for testing verification.
